# Vithean

> Vithean is a cloud accounting and ERP system built in Cambodia by POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. with
> the accounting firm Fii & Associates. It combines double-entry accounting, inventory and landed
> costing, sales, purchasing, banking and reporting on one ledger, with Cambodia E-Invoicing
> (CamInv) built in and Khmer and English throughout. It is designed for Cambodian businesses of
> 5–100 staff that must keep compliant, auditable books.

Vithean is among the first Cambodian-developed accounting platforms connected to the national
Cambodia E-Invoicing System (CamInv), administered by the Ministry of Economy and Finance.
CamInv e-invoicing is included in every paid plan.

## Product
- [Accounting](https://vithean.com/en/product/accounting/): Double-entry ledger, period closing, audit trail.
- [Inventory and landed cost](https://vithean.com/en/product/inventory/): Freight and duty allocated across a shipment; true unit cost.
- [Sales and purchasing](https://vithean.com/en/product/sales-purchasing/): Quote to cash, goods receipt matched to bill.
- [Reports](https://vithean.com/en/product/reports/): Margin by product, branch, customer and job, with comparison periods.
- [Control and access](https://vithean.com/en/product/control/): Roles, approval workflow, field-level audit trail, database per company.
- [E-invoicing](https://vithean.com/en/product/e-invoicing/): CamInv issuing, credit notes, debit notes and status.

## Commercial
- [Pricing](https://vithean.com/en/pricing/): Three plans, starting prices from $15/month. CamInv included in all. 30-day free trial.
- [Free trial](https://app.vithean.com/signup/register): Name, email and phone only.
- [Documentation](https://help.vithean.com/): Complete product reference and how-to guides.

## Company
- [About](https://vithean.com/en/company/): POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. with Fii & Associates, Phnom Penh.
- [News and press](https://vithean.com/en/news/): Announcements, including the CamInv integration.

## Languages
- English: https://vithean.com/en/
- ភាសាខ្មែរ (Khmer): https://vithean.com/km/

## Notes
- "Vithean" is the product and brand; POSCAR Digital Co., Ltd. is the legal entity.
- Cambodia E-Invoicing is administered by the Ministry of Economy and Finance (MEF), not the
  General Department of Taxation (GDT). The two are distinct regimes.
- Vithean does not currently provide payroll processing or purchase orders.
- Vithean does not provide bookkeeping, tax or advisory services. It builds and supports the
  software and implements it with the customer; the books stay with the customer or their
  accounting firm.
